Abdulelah Al-Amri.note: What separates Al-Amri is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Al-Amri holds the route into the box until support arrives. At another point, he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Abdulelah Al-Amri.noteZh: 理解Abdulelah Al-Amri，要先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Abdullah Al-Hamdan.note: Al-Hamdan's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Watch how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Separately, he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Abdullah Al-Hamdan.noteZh: 理解Abdullah Al-Hamdan，要先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Abdullah Al-Khaibari.note: For Al-Khaibari, the foundation is reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. Look first at how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. Beyond the first action, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Abdullah Al-Khaibari.noteZh: 最能体现Abdullah Al-Khaibari特点的是对抗后球权松动时的第一反应。这一点直接体现在他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。除此之外，他也会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Ahmed Al-Kassar.summary: Ahmed Al-Kassar is a Saudi Arabia goalkeeper from Al-Qadsiah who brings experience, reaction saves, and penalty-area control.
Ahmed Al-Kassar.note: The key to Al-Kassar is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. Elsewhere in the game, Al-Kassar leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Ahmed Al-Kassar.noteZh: 理解Ahmed Al-Kassar，要先看提前站位后的快速反应。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Alaa Hejji.summary: Alaa Hejji is a Saudi Arabia central midfielder from NEOM SC who helps connect possession and support counter-pressing phases.
Alaa Hejji.note: Al Hejji's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Separately, he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Alaa Hejji.noteZh: 压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定是理解Alaa Al Hejji踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Ali Lajami.note: What separates Lajami is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. Lajami protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. In another phase of play, he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Ali Lajami.noteZh: 最能体现Ali Lajami特点的是对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。这一点直接体现在他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。除此之外，他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ali Majrashi.note: Majrashi's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He also turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Ali Majrashi.noteZh: Ali Majrashi最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Ayman Yahya.note: Watch Yahya for changing direction without losing control of the ball. The clearest example is how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. A separate clue is how Yahya waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ayman Yahya.noteZh: Ayman Yahya的比赛建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下之上。首先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个方面是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Firas Al-Buraikan.note: Al-Buraikan stands out for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. Al-Buraikan also protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Firas Al-Buraikan.noteZh: Firas Al-Buraikan最鲜明的特点是防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。一个直接线索是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。另一个独立细节是他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Hassan Al-Tambakti.note: The key to Al-Tambakti is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. There is another side to his game: he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Hassan Al-Tambakti.noteZh: Hassan Al-Tambakti最鲜明的特点是防线暴露后的回追速度。一个直接线索是他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。另一个独立细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Hassan Kadesh.summary: Hassan Kadesh is a Saudi Arabia left-back from Al-Ittihad who gives the team left-footed balance, defensive experience, and set-piece presence.
Hassan Kadesh.note: What separates Kadesh is staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. Kadesh checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. A separate detail appears when he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Hassan Kadesh.noteZh: 看Hassan Kadesh的作用，关键是球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动。他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Jehad Thakri.summary: Jehad Thakri is a Saudi Arabia centre-back from Al-Qadsiah who adds size, aerial defending, and squad depth.
Jehad Thakri.note: For Thakri, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Beyond that, watch how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Jehad Thakri.noteZh: 观察Jehad Thakri时，可以先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个比赛细节是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Khalid Al-Ghannam.note: Al-Ghannam stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. A different question is whether he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Khalid Al-Ghannam.noteZh: Khalid Al-Ghannam的优势在于变向时仍把球控制在脚下。最直接的表现是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。想看得更完整，还要观察他是否会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Mohamed Kanno.note: For Kanno, the foundation is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Look first at how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. A separate point is how he absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Mohamed Kanno.noteZh: Mohamed Kanno的优势在于等防守者注意力转移后再启动。最直接的表现是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个值得观察的细节是他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.summary: Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat is a Saudi Arabia right-back from Al-Qadsiah who offers recovery speed, overlap timing, and defensive energy.
Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.note: Al-Shamat's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He also turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.noteZh: 观察Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat时，可以先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个比赛细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Mohammed Al-Owais.note: Watch Al-Owais for staying ready through long quiet spells. The clearest example is how he keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. Elsewhere, Al-Owais keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements.
Mohammed Al-Owais.noteZh: 最能体现Mohammed Al-Owais特点的是长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。这一点直接体现在他会在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。除此之外，他也会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。

Moteb Al-Harbi.summary: Moteb Al-Harbi is a Saudi Arabia left-back from Al-Hilal who brings overlap timing, recovery defending, and left-footed service.
Moteb Al-Harbi.note: For Al-Harbi, the foundation is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Look first at how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Beyond that, watch how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Moteb Al-Harbi.noteZh: Moteb Al-Harbi的优势在于从后场加入进攻的启动时机。最直接的表现是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个值得观察的细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Musab Al-Juwayr.note: Al-Juwayr stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Also look at how Al-Juwayr uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Musab Al-Juwayr.noteZh: 看Musab Al-Juwayr的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Nasser Al-Dawsari.summary: Nasser Al-Dawsari is a Saudi Arabia central midfielder from Al-Hilal who adds coverage, passing discipline, and late shooting threat.
Nasser Al-Dawsari.note: What separates Al-Dawsari is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Al-Dawsari holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. Away from that action, he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Nasser Al-Dawsari.noteZh: Nasser Al-Dawsari的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个方面是他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Nawaf Al-Aqidi.note: Al-Aqidi stands out for command of the crowded space around goal. He attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. Al-Aqidi also keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled.
Nawaf Al-Aqidi.noteZh: Nawaf Al-Aqidi最鲜明的特点是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。一个直接线索是他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。另一个独立细节是他会让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。

Nawaf Boushal.summary: Nawaf Boushal is a Saudi Arabia right-back from Al-Nassr who brings overlap energy, recovery speed, and wide defensive bite.
Nawaf Boushal.note: Watch Boushal for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. The clearest example is how he turns early and closes the runner before the box. In a different phase, Boushal gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Nawaf Boushal.noteZh: 理解Nawaf Boushal，要先看防线暴露后的回追速度。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Saleh Al-Shehri.note: The key to Al-Shehri is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Elsewhere in the game, Al-Shehri meets the pass without adding an extra touch.
Saleh Al-Shehri.noteZh: 理解Saleh Al-Shehri，要先看等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会迎球直接完成射门，不增加调整触球。

Salem Al-Dawsari.note: The key to Al-Dawsari is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. There is another side to his game: he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Salem Al-Dawsari.noteZh: 理解Salem Al-Dawsari，要先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Saud Abdulhamid.note: Watch Abdulhamid for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Elsewhere, Abdulhamid turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Saud Abdulhamid.noteZh: 看Saud Abdulhamid的作用，关键是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Sultan Mandash.note: Mandash stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Also look at how Mandash draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Sultan Mandash.noteZh: Sultan Mandash最鲜明的特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。一个直接线索是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个独立细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Ziyad Al-Johani.summary: Ziyad Al-Johani is a Saudi Arabia defensive midfielder from Al-Ahli who adds ball winning, central coverage, and short progression.
Ziyad Al-Johani.note: The key to Al-Johani is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. In another phase, Al-Johani takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Ziyad Al-Johani.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Ziyad Al-Johani踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。
